fields.label: Start When
fields.help: event: something happens in an org (needs Org Name). endpoint: a message reaches this workflow's automation role.

fields.label: Event Types
fields.help: Comma-separated: status, message, xorg, gate, question, asset, tool, usage, audit. Empty = all.

fields.label: Role
fields.help: Only events from or to this role.

fields.label: Subject Contains
fields.help: Only messages whose subject (or gates whose name) contains this text.

fields.label: Question Kind
fields.help: For question events: ask_human questions only (default), tool approvals only, or both.

outputs.description: the org event or message that fired the trigger
